_note: Bottle Shot finale, played inside the gang's stash. The district picks the weapon and the stash set; the level's place inside its district (0 = first, 9 = boss) picks the difficulty row. Bottles stand on a plane `distance` metres in front of the hero (x sideways, y height above the stand's floor). Shots = target bottles (normal + gold) + spare. Coins (spec v2.1 section 3.1): economy.json payout (Economy.level_coins: bottles broken, up to 4, and the gold bottle add at most about 0.7x of a plain win); clear_bonus, per_troop, bonus_per_bottle and gold_mult are kept only for old tooling and no longer pay. combo = 1 + combo_step x (hits in a row - 1), capped at combo_max; a miss or a decoy resets it; it only drives the HUD's flame (which shows the streak length).
_level_weapon_note: Spec v2.1 §4.3: guest weapons, given as a gift for that level. level_weapon maps a level to a later district's Bottle Shot weapon (never a district's first level or its boss); every other level uses its district's weapon. A guest is played in its own stash set (the stash of the district whose weapon it is: the sniper needs its rooftop, the pistol its shooting gallery) with the level's difficulty row, uses the player's Armory tier for it (base tier if none), and gets gift.spare extra shots. Its first use plays that weapon's ghost-hand lesson as usual. The schedule rotates (review v2.1): no guest follows itself, a district's guests all differ, and the same slot carries a different guest in neighbouring districts.

gift._note: The gift reveal (src/finale/gift_reveal.gd) at the burst into the stash, before aiming, on every attempt; a tap skips it. Phases in real seconds: the box drops in (drop_s), wiggles (wiggle_s), bursts open in sparkles (open_s), the weapon spins up out of it (spin_s, `turns` full turns, slowing to face the player) and flies into the hand (fly_s). The sum is squeezed into max_s (at most 1.5). box / weapon = sizes as a share of the screen width; dim = backdrop darkness; sparks = burst particles. A locked Armory track shows a lock and its unlock level under the weapon.

difficulty._note: One entry per level inside a district. count = normal bottles (one gold bottle is added), decoys = clay jugs that reset the combo, spare = shots beyond one per target, size = bottle and hit-zone scale, dist = x the weapon's distance, amp/speed = motion (metres, rad/s), wind = metres/s^2 of sideways push at most (bow only).

knife._note: Drag to aim, release to throw. Straight line plus a small visual arc; slow-motion chase camera.

pistol._note: First person, iron sights. mag rounds per magazine; reload_s = reload animation; kick_deg = muzzle rise per shot, recovered over recover_s. speed = bullet speed along the range (m/s); slow = time scale while a bullet is out. Bullet cam (pistol, bow, sniper; a shot that will break a bottle; a tap skips it): the flight lasts about cam_s real seconds (time scale = flight / cam_s, at least cam_min_scale), filmed by a camera cam_rig = [back, side, up, lead] metres from the projectile (cam_bullet = the round's drawn scale); the camera stops cam_stop metres short of the bottle and holds on the shatter for cam_hold real seconds while the clock comes back from cam_hold_scale to exactly 1.

bow._note: First person. Hold to draw (draw_s to full), drag to aim, release to loose. The pin sight is set for a full draw with no wind at the base distance; held at full draw past steady_s the tired arm makes the pin drift slowly (at most shake_deg, eased in over 2.5 s, under 1 Hz) and its ring turns amber (owner 2026-11-13: it used to shake at 2-5 Hz up to 1.35 degrees). Wind pushes sideways (difficulty.wind x wind). Bullet cam numbers: see pistol.

stars._note: Swipe: direction aims, swipe speed sets the throw speed (slow = drops). Steel plates beside the rows bounce a star along the row for ricochet_len metres.

sniper._note: Rooftop to rooftop. Touch to raise the scope, drag to aim, release to fire. Sway = slow breathing (sway_deg) + slow tremor (tremor_deg, about 1.3 Hz), functions of the time held: steady_k x sway_deg until steady_s after scoping in, then it rises smoothly over worse_s to worse_k (at most 1) and stays there, shown by the breath arc on the scope's rim (owner 2026-11-13: worse_k was 2.4 with a 30 Hz tremor, the 'aggressive' jump after 2-3 s). Zeroed at `zero` metres. cycle_s = bolt action. Bullet cam numbers: see pistol. fog_mult = the street fog's density while the far roof is shot (a daylight district's fog washes the set out; v2.1 guest snipers).
